description: Price a Guard — CurrencyGuard's FX protection product for real future payments or receipts. If a tenor like '3 months' is given, call resolve_settlement_date first to get the exact date, then call this tool. Returns: guardType (Guard-Pay or Guard-Receive), guardRate, guardFee, guardFeePercent, effectiveRate, guardAmount (home currency equivalent), foreignAmount, spotRate, settlementDate, settlementWindowOpens, valid, errors. All quotes are indicative.

foreignAmount.description: Amount in foreign currency to protect

foreignCurrency.description: Foreign currency ISO code, e.g. USD

guardCurrency.description: Home/base currency ISO code, e.g. GBP

guardRate.description: Fixed Guard rate to price at instead of the current market rate. Leave empty to price at the current rate.

payReceive.description: PAY if paying foreign currency, RECEIVE if receiving it

settlementDate.description: Settlement date in ISO format YYYY-MM-DD

name: price_guard
title: Price a Guard
